title: Run generation quota
appliesWhen: Managed owner run without explicit managedBudget; factory injects ProjectRunBudgets.
stops: Next generation refused with RUN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.
recommendedChange: Versioned optional aggregate cap; preserve explicit user limits and historical charges.
requiredTests: Beyond64 without cap; explicit64 blocks before dispatch; restart/idempotency preserve charges.

title: Run output reservation quota
appliesWhen: Reserves request output allowance, not actual completion tokens.
stops: Output grant shrinks; less than minimum headroom stops generation.
recommendedChange: Make aggregate cap optional; retain reserved/observed/unknown usage as distinct facts.
requiredTests: Unlimited total with finite request output; exact finite-cap shrink; unknown outcome never refunded.

title: Run tool and check quota
appliesWhen: Model batches and selected service checks share the same owner ledger.
stops: Next tool/check rejected before effects.
recommendedChange: Optional user cap; preserve atomic effect admission.
requiredTests: More than256 known effects without cap; explicit cap; service-check charges; no duplicated effects.

title: Review reserve reduces work allowance
appliesWhen: Default64/131072/256 policy; coordinator/planning/integration share work phase.
stops: Work stops at56 requests despite global64; review reserve is a protected minimum, not a review maximum.
recommendedChange: Reserve only within an explicitly finite user envelope.
requiredTests: Work56 blocked, review8 available; no artificial subtraction in observation-only mode.

title: Finite required cap schema and constructor
defaultValue: Required positive integer caps; missing settings acquire defaults; null/zero/Infinity unsupported
appliesWhen: Runtime construction, policy parsing and checkpoint load.
stops: Deleting settings does not create unlimited mode.
recommendedChange: Explicit version2 optional caps, separate mandatory model/request capacity; avoid huge sentinels.
requiredTests: Omitted/null wire behavior; oldv1 roundtrip; new no-cap state; migration retains receipts.

title: Budget operation-count storage ceiling
appliesWhen: Every ledger validation.
stops: More than17408 operation keys invalidates ledger even after numeric quotas are removed.
recommendedChange: Paged/append-only receipts with bounded summaries and versioned validation.
requiredTests: More than17408 receipts; duplicate/conflicting operations; recovery and summaries.

title: Per-turn generation quota
appliesWhen: Includes work, closing and final JSON within each turn.
stops: Loop exhausts MODEL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED independently of run cap.
recommendedChange: Optional turn cap or resumable yielding; no hidden replacement for absent run cap.
requiredTests: Beyond24 requests, close/final charges, pending-chain-preserving yield.

title: Per-turn model-tool and check quota
appliesWhen: Requested tool calls plus worker service checks.
stops: TOOL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED can prevent the check itself.
recommendedChange: Optional user quota; retain batch/payload and effect safety.
requiredTests: Valid large batches; checks counted; no reset on rollover; explicit cap stops before effects.

title: Lifetime session request quota
appliesWhen: Cumulative across explicit turns and windows.
stops: MODEL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED despite larger/unlimited owning-run allowance.
recommendedChange: Optional user cap; never reset session history/accounting to fake unlimited.
requiredTests: Beyond256 across turns/restarts without cap; explicit cap remains enforced.

title: Configured model context
appliesWhen: Managed default; actual model capability may differ.
stops: Configured above inspected Ollama capability rejects; local schema also forbids capacities outside its range.
recommendedChange: Use inspected model/hardware capacity and explicit preference, with safe context assembly.
requiredTests: Below/above32K models, larger model capabilities, runtime identity and no silent truncation.

title: Per-request output setting and incomplete finish
appliesWhen: Ollama num_predict or DeepSeek max_tokens; must be below context.
stops: Provider length/failed finish becomes MODEL_INCOMPLETE; partial result is not completion.
recommendedChange: Model/task-aware request headroom distinct from goal total; support proven known-outcome continuation.
requiredTests: Large patches; partial tool JSON not executed; final length outcome; finite request plus unlimited total.

title: Byte-based context admission and minimum headroom
defaultValue: UTF8 bytes of serialized messages/tools/schema +16/message; require min(128, configuredOutput) headroom
appliesWhen: Before each HTTP generation.
stops: MODEL_CONTEXT_EXHAUSTED can be a conservative rejection before provider sees the prompt, not physical overflow.
recommendedChange: Trusted tokenizer/provider-aware estimator and precise context views; never discard required constraints.
requiredTests: ASCII/Cyrillic/code/templates; compare observed prompt tokens; no underestimated dispatch; small JSON contracts.

title: Estimator locked even for injected policy
appliesWhen: Custom request-policy injection.
stops: Accurate smaller tokenizer estimate is currently INVALID_REQUEST_POLICY.
recommendedChange: Separate trusted estimator port/revision from output policy; do not trust arbitrary smaller values.
requiredTests: Estimator provenance, revision pinning, malformed result and conservative fallback.

title: Worker-only segmentation and early closing
appliesWhen: Only assigned writable implementation sessions with injected evidence/policy; coordinator/reviewer do not segment.
stops: Triggers handshake after3 completed tool rounds or60% estimated pressure, often before any edit. Other phases still hit context.
recommendedChange: Model/context/progress-aware phase views, without universal round-triggered close.
requiredTests: Pure reads vs novel evidence; coordinator/reviewer history; closure costs; scope and continuation retained.

title: Raw-history pressure differs from actual request view
defaultValue: Rotation estimates raw session.messages; actual admission uses provider.contextMessages
appliesWhen: Ollama non-thinking projection may omit known assistant commentary.
stops: Can rotate earlier than the actual packet requires.
recommendedChange: One versioned request view for admission and scheduling; retain full private log.
requiredTests: Raw/private history preserved; projected tool chains complete; consistent estimates.

title: Four-window lifetime and archive schema ceiling
appliesWhen: Closing continue or check-feedback handoff; starts at index1.
stops: WORK_SEGMENT_LIMIT at4; removing4 alone still fails policy/schema at17th window.
recommendedChange: No default lifetime-window quota; version/paginate archives and state-based continuation.
requiredTests: Five-plus and17-plus windows; same identity/scope/model/usage; old checkpoints; unknown effects never replay.

title: Closing protocol consumes output and requests
appliesWhen: Each forced close; ordinary Ollama work completion also requires separate final JSON.
stops: All bookkeeping consumes request quotas/context; malformed/incomplete close stops.
recommendedChange: Measure/minimize model bookkeeping at settled boundaries, preserving provider continuation and acceptance separation.
requiredTests: All closes/finals charged; malformed/length close; separate-turn tools forbidden in final phase; archive provenance.

title: Two automatic worker-check feedback steps
appliesWhen: Sole assigned writable managed worker, frozen check failure.
stops: WORKER_CHECK_FEEDBACK_LIMIT independently of run/session allowance.
recommendedChange: Version optional user repair cap and progress-driven replanning; update literal2 checkpoint/type/transition constraints too.
requiredTests: Third-plus repair without cap; explicit cap; no stacked double allowance; restart retains counters.

title: Step-check count and diagnostic projections
appliesWhen: Worker-step check plans/results and focused feedback; check ID can run many assertions.
stops: More than8 command IDs invalid; truncated detail may omit actionable errors.
recommendedChange: Batch complete check sets and expose authorized detailed evidence references; never silently skip checks.
requiredTests: Nine check IDs, partial/unavailable outcomes, long compiler errors, fingerprint-bound detail retrieval.

title: Historical receipt handoff projection
appliesWhen: Fresh worker window gets original anchor task plus bounded observed receipts.
stops: May lose useful read text and require repeated reads; original source in anchor can now be stale.
recommendedChange: Retrievable verified artifact references, explicit source revision, no private continuation exposure.
requiredTests: Needed seventh/long receipt; changed current file; historical outputs never treated as current or replay instructions.

title: Changed-file evidence manifest bounds
appliesWhen: Changed/untracked public files, not all unchanged repository files.
stops: SEGMENT_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE prevents rollover/check if exceeded.
recommendedChange: Page manifests or split tasks without omitting affected paths; preserve symlink/privacy checks.
requiredTests: 257 changed paths, big file,32MiB aggregate, deletions/modes, complete cross-page fingerprint.

title: Git evidence operation bounds
appliesWhen: Git identity/diff/untracked scans.
stops: Slow Git/large filename output yields unavailable evidence.
recommendedChange: Keep operation-health and output safeguards; stream/page manifests for large tasks.
requiredTests: Slow disk, huge filename set, abort cleanup and partial evidence rejected.

title: Inactivity watchdogs
appliesWhen: Production uses10min; callers can choose another timeout. Research adapter120s is not production default.
stops: Managed abort or native interruption after silence; preserves work, may require unknown-effect reconciliation.
recommendedChange: Treat operation health separately from optional goal wall quota; expose waiting/loading states and resumable interruption.
requiredTests: Healthy long streams; long load/queue; genuine stalled stream; unknown state remains charged.

title: Endpoint capacity and queue
appliesWhen: All runtimes sharing provider-kind/normalized endpoint share FIFO gate.
stops: Limits simultaneous inference, not goal/session total; no queue-size ceiling here.
recommendedChange: Keep capacity scheduling, queue rather than fail; use measured hardware/user preference.
requiredTests: Many sessions/one model; queued cancellation; aliases sharing gate; no excess parallel grants.

title: Waiting can consume inactivity allowance
defaultValue: Watchdog starts before provider metadata inspection/gate wait
appliesWhen: Busy endpoint/model load with no stream progress.
stops: Healthy queued work may be aborted as if generation stalled.
recommendedChange: Separate queued/loading/streaming/tool states; start silence clock at actual dispatch.
requiredTests: Queue waits longer than idle threshold; cancellation/fairness; metadata load vs stuck stream.

title: HTTP stream response cap
appliesWhen: Entire response including reasoning/tool args; common JSON parser also uses it.
stops: MODEL_RESPONSE_LIMIT above4MiB; reader cancels.
recommendedChange: Keep technical safety bound or stream large artifact content; never silently accept partial response.
requiredTests: Oversized response, cancellation, UTF8 errors, partial tool args never dispatched.

title: Native RPC and discovery bounds
appliesWhen: Native startup and JSONL RPC acknowledgements; MCP list verified twice before app-server.
stops: Session/RPC may fail before turn ID; inherited MCP hardening remains required.
recommendedChange: Operation-aware health/status and reconciliation, not a goal budget or blind retry.
requiredTests: Lost accepted ack; slow startup; large MCP list; inherited servers all disabled; abort before ID.

title: Native shutdown escalation
appliesWhen: Disposing owned app-server.
stops: Closes/kills owned process and waits for close.
recommendedChange: Retain lifecycle cleanup independently of resource policy.
requiredTests: Ignore graceful shutdown; pending RPC rejection; final checks only after process quiescence.

title: Native accounting coverage
defaultValue: Hidden native API calls not metered by managed ledger
appliesWhen: Codex route may provide observed tokens but not managed reservation coverage.
stops: Cannot claim aggregate managed request/token enforcement for native internals.
recommendedChange: Capability-aware user controls, explicit unknown coverage, no fake zero-cost comparison.
requiredTests: Native/mixed usage, unknown vszero, unsupported cap enforcement visible.

title: Unknown effects and usage-integrity gates
defaultValue: No replay of pending/unknown generation/action/check; invalid accounting poisons ledger
appliesWhen: Incomplete saved outcome or provider usage exceeding request reservation.
stops: Reconciliation-required or RUN_BUDGET_USAGE_EXCEEDED prevents more effects.
recommendedChange: Keep idempotency/unknown-state safeguards; separate telemetry/provider-contract failure from optional aggregate quota.
requiredTests: Restart/lost responses, no repeated side effect, malformed usage, observation-only recovery.

title: Frozen policy identity complicates migration
defaultValue: Resource revision includes runtime limits + estimator revision + segment limits; private session limits immutable
appliesWhen: Current defaults or strategy changed before resume.
stops: Historical route/checkpoint can fail closed even with unchanged model/source.
recommendedChange: Clean pre-release cutover: archive old runtime state without executing it; no legacy resolver or old checkpoint support. Preserve endpoint/model identity and durable recovery for new-format runs.
requiredTests: Old checkpoint explicitly unsupported without replay; new-format recovery and explicit quota change retain IDs/receipts; endpoint/model cannot silently move.

title: Public display excerpt and long-run whole-record growth

defaultValue.privateRecordStorage: whole JSON read/clone/atomic rewrite; no explicit byte cap

appliesWhen: Display projection versus complete private records and returned model text.
stops: Display excerpt does not truncate acceptance parser; long histories can create memory/I/O/storage pressure after quota removal.
recommendedChange: Bound public views; page/append private sessions/effect receipts with complete recovery provenance.
requiredTests: Full final envelope vs excerpt; long-run paging/restart; atomic writes; counters never wrap.
